messages:
Tara (CS): Quick heads-up — three customers came up in onboarding this week with product asks that affect activation, and one flagged a potential renewal risk. Can we triage?

Raj (CS): TL;DR list? names + short ask pls.

Tara (CS): Sure — short list: 
- NovaHealth: wants per-route billing toggle during trial (makes finance sign-off easier).
- ClearLane: requests granular webhook for embedding refresh events (they're building a realtime annotator).
- BrightCove AI: needs faster warm-start latency for 2k token prompts (onboarding tests failing >3s).
- AtlasCare: renewal at EoQ, said login + org-level audit logs are required or they won't renew.

Jin (PM): Thanks. Quick clarifying Qs: which of these block onboarding vs nice-to-have?

Tara (CS): NovaHealth = blocker for finance sign-off (onboarding blocked).
ClearLane = nice-to-have but will speed adoption.
BrightCove = borderline blocker (test suite fails, they paused full pilot).
AtlasCare = renewal risk unless we provide org audit/ACL details (security).

Sophie (Prod Ops): For BrightCove latency — are they on Dedicated or Hosted? Routing matters.

Raj (CS): They're on Hosted in us-west. It spikes when seq len >1500.

Alex (Eng): Got it. Likely tail latency from KV cache misses + model variant. We can:
1) suggest temporary config: pin to a lower-latency model variant + pre-warm requests,
2) long-term: add warm-start optimization for 2k sequences (engineering item).

Jin (PM): Prioritization proposal:
- P0: NovaHealth billing toggle (blocks onboarding + impacts $)
- P0: AtlasCare audit/ACL details (renewal risk)
- P1: BrightCove warm-start perf (affects pilot conversion)
- P2: ClearLane webhook enrichment (nice-to-have)

Tara (CS): Agree with P0/P1/P2 split. For NovaHealth billing toggle — can we ship a configurable flag in Console to toggle per-route billing visibility? Minimal UX and backend gate.

Alex (Eng): Feasible as a Config/Flag in 2 sprints if backend quota mapping is straightforward. Need spec.

Jin (PM): I'll take NovaHealth and AtlasCare spec. Action items:
- Jin: write spec for per-route billing visibility (include migration/backfill notes). ETA 3 business days.
- Jin: write security doc for org audit/ACL info for AtlasCare + compliance notes. ETA 5 business days.
- Alex: quick mitigation for BrightCove — advise pin + pre-warm, provide script. Also estimate warm-start work (ETA 2 sprints).
- Sophie: confirm infra implications for pre-warm on Hosted.
- Raj/Tara: own comms to customers with expected timelines; get acceptance.

SignalBot: NOTE: Created tracker issue CS-1429 for NovaHealth billing toggle (assign: Jin).

Raj (CS): I'll loop NovaHealth customer success manager and send proposed temporary workaround today.

Tara (CS): Also — small intake template to standardize requests when CS flags product asks. Please use for future triage: 
```
Customer: <company>
Ask: <one-line feature/bug>
Impact: onboarding | renewal | usage | none
Severity: P0|P1|P2
Workaround: <yes/no + short>
Contact: <customer owner>
```

Jin (PM): Nice. I'll add it to the CS playbook page and set up a short weekly triage slot.

Alex (Eng): FYI — I'll post a short runbook snippet for pre-warm script and config today.

Sophie (Prod Ops): Will validate Hosted cost impact for pre-warm and reply with numbers.

Tara (CS): Perfect. Closing loop here — Raj/Tara will update each customer after we have spec/mitigation. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Raj (CS): On it.

Tara (CS): End.
